But before booking, we may want to check if flight cost <= budget. But we don't know budget yet until we set it. We'll set budget first.

Also maybe we need to verify traveler info? Not necessary.

We also might want to confirm flight cost is within budget. But we can't easily compare unless we store values. But we can just proceed.

Thus we need to call compute_exchange_rate first.
